subject: Novaplay: follow-up + 6-month committed pricing scenarios and startup program
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaplay.ai>, Marco Li <marco@novaplay.ai>
Cc: procurement@novaplay.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Novaplay: post-demo recap + token economics (next steps)

Elena / Marco —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum:

Key points we agreed on the call:
- P0 workload: conversational assistant + summarization for product pages (expected avg sequence length 300-400 tokens).
- Initial consumption estimate: 1.8–2.5M tokens / month for the first 3 months as you ramp.
- Target economics: you indicated a goal near $500–$800 per 1M tokens (we noted $700 as a balancing point).

Requested from you:
1) Confirm which of the above token bands best represents your expected steady-state (pick one): 1.8M, 2.0M, or 2.5M tokens/month.
2) Confirm runway / budget window you prefer to commit against (6 months vs 12 months).
3) Any procurement constraints (prepay vs monthly invoice, PO requirements, legal redlines).

What I’m sending with this note:
- a lightweight pricing-sheet (attached) with scenarios by committed term, and a one-pager on our startup program (attached).
- If you confirm 6 months and the 2M band we’ll produce a draft SOW + billing schedule for sign-off.

Suggested next steps:
- Elena: quick reply with the band & preferred term so I can run this through the approvals queue.
- If ok, I’ll include Marissa (discount approvals) and Monica (account lead) to finalize commercial terms and get a DocuSign draft over.

Thanks — I’ll hold Monday 9/13 10–12 PT for a short sync if you want to close the commercial details.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
attachments: pricing-sheet.xlsx, redwood-startup-program-one-pager.pdf

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaplay.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novaplay.ai, Marco Li <marco@novaplay.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novaplay: post-demo recap + token economics (next steps)

Thanks Rafael — quick answers below.

1) Token band: let’s plan for 2.0M tokens/month as the initial committed band (our product team expects a conservative ramp to that within 4 weeks).
2) Term: we prefer a 6-month trial with the option to extend to 12 months if usage meets expectations.
3) Procurement notes:
   - We generally prefer prepay for committed discounts but can do monthly invoicing with a PO if necessary.
   - Need SOC2 evidence and a short data processing addendum for legal review.

On pricing — internally our finance lead pushed for a target closer to $500/1M tokens; we understand market variance, but that is the number we need to get near to justify the commitment. Can you outline the committed-use discounts that get us within ~20% of that target?

Procurement (copied) will coordinate contract logistics — their contact is procurement@novaplay.ai.

Happy to chat Monday morning PT if that helps.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product | Novaplay
elena@novaplay.ai
attachments: Novaplay-product-onepager.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaplay.ai>, procurement@novaplay.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novaplay: post-demo recap + token economics (next steps)

Perfect — thanks Elena. Looping in Marissa (discount approvals) and Monica (your account lead) to triage.

Prelim committed-use scenarios (ballpark, final numbers subject to approved program tier and signature):

Baseline (monthly, no commitment)
- Effective list: $1,000 per 1M tokens

6-month committed prepay (2.0M tokens/mo assumed)
- Discount: ~18% off baseline -> ~$820 per 1M tokens
- Total prepay for 6 months (2.0M * 6 = 12M tokens): ~$9,840

12-month committed (monthly billing or prepay)
- Discount: ~25% -> ~$750 per 1M tokens
- 12M tokens annualized for first year: ~$9,000 (spread depending on billing)

Multi-year / strategic (24+ months + committed growth)
- Discount: up to ~35% with staged pricing tiers and minimum annual commitment -> ~$650 per 1M tokens and additional engineering / onboarding credits may apply

Notes:
- Startup program: early-stage companies (Series A and earlier) can get supplemental credits and additional promo discounts; Marissa will confirm eligibility and how that stacks with committed-use pricing.
- If your target is $500/1M, that is ~50% off the baseline — getting to that level typically requires sizable multi-year commitments or an accelerator-style credit package. We can propose a hybrid: a 6-month committed band at ~18% + a startup credit pool to bridge the gap for the first 3 months.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: can you confirm startup stacking rules and whether a one-time promo credit could be applied to bring net-first-quarter effective $/1M nearer to $500?
- Monica: I’ll prepare a short SOW + billing schedule for the 6-month trial using the 2.0M band and the 18% committed discount.
- Elena / procurement: any preference for prepay vs monthly invoicing with PO? I’ll reflect that in the SOW.

I’ve attached the pricing sheet with the above scenarios (worksheet tab), and a one-pager on our startup program. If it helps, I can also produce a modeled spreadsheet showing effective $/1M after credits.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
attachments: pricing-sheet.xlsx

From: procurement@novaplay.ai

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novaplay: post-demo recap + token economics (next steps)

Rafael / Marissa / Monica —

Novaplay procurement here. We can do a 6-month prepay or monthly invoiced PO; preference is prepay to get the better committed discount. A couple items we’ll need before sign:
- SOC 2 Type II report and a DPA (we’ll send a standard redline if you have one).
- Standard insurance and indemnification language — our legal will review.
- Please include the billing schedule that shows the prepay amount and the token allotment per month.

Can you provide a draft SOW and a DocuSign link for approval? We’d like to review and, if everything looks good, route to our CFO for an expedited sign-off.

—Novaplay Procurement (procurement@novaplay.ai)
attachments: procurement-requirements.pdf
